about: The monthly benchmarks of November on REF-MAC (ROADMAP, Every month, performance), each against the first measurements of 2026-10-23 on v0.1 kept as the baseline (bench/results/history/before-2026-11-20). A result more than 10 % worse is a regression to fix before the next release. Swap held at 11.6 GB through the run (it did not grow); memory free never under 40 %. Photos are only read; no names kept.
machine: Apple M3, 16 GB, macOS 26.3.1, mains, dev app closed

sets.bench: 96 Canon JPEGs, 16 MP (the baseline counted 95 of the same folder)
sets.trip: the owner's Prague trip, 396 JPEG + 26 RAW, Lumix GX9 20 MP
sets.batch: the bench set hard-linked 53 times (5,088 paths; 5,035 in the baseline)

raw.note: nine CC0 samples, develop of the full photo

samehourPair.about: v0.1.0 built from its tag and today's build, run alternately three times each on the bench set, the same hour (DOCS_GUIDE, Performance)

verdicts.trip.peakExportRssMb: real: a RAW export holds about 2 GB even alone; over NFR-004 with today's code (the 11-04 commit gives 2.49 GB today, so part of the old 1.24 GB was the machine)
verdicts.bench.t1PerSecond: not a regression: v0.1.0's measure_folder made thumbnails on every core, today's on the app's two background threads; one thumbnail costs the same (decode 45 vs 46 ms, resize 18 ms, sRGB 0 ms)
verdicts.bench.importMs: real, small: +20 % the same hour (9.0 to 10.8 ms for 96 photos, 0.11 s per 1,000 against the 1 s budget), the new metadata fields; the owner decides
verdicts.gpu.webkitStepMs: the machine: 4 ms in three more runs, while bench/gpu and Playwright (WebKit) are unchanged since 2026-11-05 and other apps held the GPU at about 70 %
